description: Submit one registered action kind to the native mod-wm-bridge action queue. The native action kind is selected in payload.native_action_kind and must be one of the fixed server-side verbs.

player_apply_aura.notes: Applies spell_id as an aura to the scoped online player. target_player_guid must equal the scoped request PlayerGUID in Primitive Pack 1.

player_cast_spell.notes: Makes the scoped online player cast spell_id. target defaults to self and may be selected/player_target. triggered defaults true so operator scenes can use server-side instant casts.

player_set_display_id.notes: Temporarily sets the scoped player's display/native display and optional scale. restore=true calls RestoreDisplayId instead of setting a new model.

player_remove_aura.notes: Removes spell_id from the scoped online player. target_player_guid must equal the scoped request PlayerGUID in Primitive Pack 1.

player_restore_health_power.notes: Restores flat or percent health and active power. power_type may be active/current, mana, rage, focus, energy, runic_power, or numeric 0-6.

player_add_item.notes: Stores the item in bags for the scoped online player and can mark the created stack soulbound.

player_remove_item.notes: Removes a positive count of a WM-managed/reserved item from the scoped online player's inventory. Non-reserved item entries require explicit admin_override.

player_random_enchant_item.notes: Applies random-enchant table effects to one existing scoped-player weapon/armor item. selector=random_equipped picks one eligible equipped item. Existing enchant slots have a default 15% preserve chance instead of being overwritten. Tiers are clamped to 1-5; selected_enchant_slot_index rerolls exactly one slot.

player_learn_spell.notes: Teaches spell_id to the scoped online player (implemented).

player_unlearn_spell.notes: Removes learned spell_id from the scoped online player (implemented).

world_announce_to_player.notes: Sends a server announcement to the scoped player (implemented). Accepts message or text.

player_chat_message.notes: Sends a scoped chat-box WM message to the online player. style may be channel, whisper, or system; channel_name defaults to WM and sender_name defaults to WorldMaster.

quest_add.notes: Adds quest_id to the scoped online player using GM .quest add style sanity checks and emits a native quest/granted event.

quest_remove.notes: Removes an active WM-managed/reserved quest from the scoped online player's quest log and emits a native quest/removed event. Non-reserved quest ids require explicit admin_override; rewarded history is kept unless remove_rewarded is true.

player_add_money.notes: Adds a positive copper amount to the scoped online player. 'copper' is the total in COPPER, not gold. Convert from what the player asked: 1 gold = 10000 copper, 1 silver = 100 copper. Examples: '10 gold' -> copper=100000; '5 silver' -> copper=500; '50 copper' -> copper=50.

player_add_reputation.notes: Adjusts one faction for the scoped online player; no_spillover defaults true.

creature_spawn.notes: Spawns a temporary WM-owned creature near the scoped player and records it in wm_bridge_world_object with LiveGUIDLow. Provide creature_name (e.g. 'deer', 'wolf') and WM resolves it to a creature_entry automatically, or pass a known creature_entry directly. The creature appears near the player; no coordinates are needed.

creature_despawn.notes: Despawns only a creature row owned by the scoped player in wm_bridge_world_object.

creature_say.notes: Makes only a scoped WM-owned creature say text.

creature_emote.notes: Runs an emote id and/or text emote on only a scoped WM-owned creature.

creature_cast_spell.notes: Makes only a scoped WM-owned creature cast spell_id. target defaults to the scoped player and may be self/creature or selected/player_target.

creature_set_display_id.notes: Sets or restores display/native display for only a scoped WM-owned live creature.

creature_set_scale.notes: Sets object scale for only a scoped WM-owned live creature. Native clamps scale to 0.10-5.00.

creature_set_name.notes: Sets the runtime name of a scoped WM-owned creature (Nemesis naming). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_set_subname.notes: Sets the runtime subname/title of a scoped WM-owned creature. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_set_faction.notes: Sets faction template of a scoped WM-owned creature (hostile Nemesis). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_set_npc_flags.notes: Sets NPCFLAG bitmask on a scoped WM-owned creature (questgiver/vendor). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_set_health_pct.notes: Sets current health as a 1-100 percent of max on a scoped WM-owned creature. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_move_to.notes: Point-moves a scoped WM-owned creature. run defaults true. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_follow_player.notes: Makes a scoped WM-owned creature follow the scoped player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_stop_movement.notes: Stops movement on a scoped WM-owned creature. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_set_react_state.notes: Sets AI react state (passive/defensive/aggressive) on a scoped WM-owned creature. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_attack_player.notes: Makes a scoped WM-owned creature attack the scoped player (Nemesis ambush). High risk; not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_attack_target.notes: Makes a scoped WM-owned creature attack a scoped target. High risk; not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_yell.notes: Zone yell from a scoped WM-owned creature. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

creature_whisper_player.notes: Whisper from a scoped WM-owned creature to the scoped player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

gameobject_spawn.notes: Spawns a temporary WM-owned gameobject near the scoped player, recorded in wm_bridge_world_object. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

gameobject_despawn.notes: Despawns only a gameobject row owned by the scoped player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

gameobject_set_state.notes: Sets GO state on a scoped WM-owned gameobject. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

companion_spawn.notes: Spawns a scoped WM companion for the player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

companion_despawn.notes: Despawns a scoped WM companion owned by the player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

companion_follow.notes: Makes a scoped WM companion follow the player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

companion_say.notes: Makes a scoped WM companion say text. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

companion_emote.notes: Runs an emote and/or text on a scoped WM companion. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

player_add_title.notes: Grants a CharTitles title to the scoped player (Local Legend). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

player_remove_title.notes: Removes a CharTitles title from the scoped player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

player_teleport.notes: Teleports the scoped player. High risk; not implemented until lab-hardened.

player_play_sound.notes: Plays a SoundEntries id for the scoped player (scene punctuation). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

player_send_mail.notes: Sends WM mail to the scoped player (rumor letter without item). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

player_send_mail_with_items.notes: Sends WM mail with attached WM-managed items. items is a list of {item_id,count}. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

wm_counter_set.notes: Sets a hidden WM progress counter for the scoped player (Oath/Nemesis state). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

wm_counter_increment.notes: Increments a hidden WM progress counter (delta defaults 1). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

wm_counter_clear.notes: Clears a hidden WM progress counter for the scoped player. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

quest_complete_objective.notes: Satisfies one objective of a scoped player's WM quest. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

quest_complete.notes: Force-completes a scoped player's WM quest (all objectives). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

quest_fail.notes: Fails a scoped player's WM quest (Oath breach). Not implemented until lab-hardened.

zone_set_weather.notes: Sets a scoped zone weather override (scene mood). Blocked until a native weather executor exists; not implemented until lab-hardened.

zone_clear_weather_override.notes: Clears a WM zone weather override. Not implemented until lab-hardened.

guardrails: No arbitrary SQL, shell command, GM command, or file edit payloads are accepted.
The C++ module validates player scope and DB policy again before executing.
Priority, sequence, target coordinate, and expiry fields are queue metadata; action-specific payload data stays inside payload.
Sequence submission is a manual/admin testing path first, not a default LLM multi-action saga path.
Most mutation verbs are policy-disabled and/or not implemented until hardened in the lab.
